author: Amisha Gurbani
title: Zucchini, Corn and Peach Orzo Salad
ingredients: 1 large or 2 medium-sized zucchini, sliced vertically into half, then sliced into ¼-inch slices
8 ounces halloumi, cut into ⅓-inch slices
2 cups orzo, cooked per packaged instructions
2 yellow peaches, cut into small cubes
1 large or 2 medium-sized zucchini, sliced vertically into half, then sliced into ¼-inch slices
8 ounces halloumi, cut into ⅓-inch slices
2 cups orzo, cooked per packaged instructions
2 yellow peaches, cut into small cubes

instructions:
Add all the ingredients in a high-speed blender and blend to a smooth vinaigrette. Pour it into a glass jar and refrigerate until ready to use.
Preheat the oven to 400 degrees. Spray a half baking sheet with cooking spray. Add the sliced zucchini, olive oil, salt, pepper and garlic powder and toss until well combined. Lay them flat such that they are not overlapping. Sprinkle half of the Parmesan onto each zucchini slice. Bake for about 20 to 25 minutes or until the zucchini is golden brown in color. Using a small offset spatula, flip them over and sprinkle the Parmesan on the slices. Bake for another 20 to 25 minutes or until the zucchini is golden brown in color. Cool completely as it will turn crisp.
Spray cooking spray on a grill pan on medium heat. Add the halloumi slices, not overlapping each other, and grill for about 2-3 minutes, or until you see golden brown grill marks. Flip and repeat on the other side to get the grill marks. Set aside until ready to toss in the salad.
In a large platter, add the freshly cooked orzo, while still warm; grilled corn; peaches; grilled halloumi; and oregano. Mix in most of the pistachios, setting about 2 tablespoons aside. Pour the basil vinaigrette all over the orzo salad and toss until well combined. Garnish with the chopped pistachios, basil leaves and yellow peach slices. Serve at room temperature. Note: This dish can be made a day ahead and served at room temperature the next day.
